name: Host creates a phone and generates a pairing code
description: Verifies a host can create a phone record and obtain a one-time pairing string for the Android agent.
steps: Sign in with the test identity
Add Samsung Galaxy A54 in Latvia with Android 14 and 5G
Click Connect on the new phone
Confirm a Download Android Agent link is shown in the pairing panel
expected: A pairing panel appears below the phone with a one-time pairing string, a copy button, and a visible Android Agent download link.

name: Host device list shows connection state after reload
setup: Sign in as a host and add a phone
description: Verifies host device status is server-derived and remains visible after reloading the dashboard.
expected: The phone remains listed with a connection badge and last-heartbeat information.

name: Renter is kept out of host device management
description: Verifies a renter receives the renter dashboard without host pairing controls.
steps: Sign in with a fresh test identity
expected: The renter dashboard is visible and no Add phone or Connect controls are shown.

name: Phone form rejects missing required details
setup: Sign in and choose Phone owner
description: Verifies incomplete device information is blocked and no phone is added.
steps: Leave Model empty while filling Country and Android version
expected: Required-field validation blocks submission and the phone count does not increase.

name: Language selection survives reload
description: Verifies the language selector changes and persists the interface language.
steps: Change language from Russian to English
Confirm the rent action is in English
expected: English remains selected and the interface stays in English.

name: Phone form draft survives automatic dashboard refresh
setup: Sign in and choose Phone owner
Open Add phone
description: Verifies typed device details are not cleared when the host dashboard refreshes device presence.
steps: Type Samsung Galaxy A54 as Model
Wait for an automatic dashboard refresh
expected: All typed form values remain visible and unchanged after the refresh.

name: Brand navigation keeps the Google session
setup: Sign in with the test identity and open the dashboard
description: Verifies tapping PhoneBridge returns to the home view without signing the user out.
expected: The user remains signed in throughout and is not asked to authenticate with Google again.

name: Host phone appears in shared rental catalog
setup: Sign in as Phone owner
Add a phone and pair it with an active Agent heartbeat
description: Verifies a host-owned connected phone becomes visible in the shared catalog that can be opened independently of account role.
steps: Open Dashboard so the device is synchronized
expected: The connected phone is listed in Catalog with its model, country, network, $1/hour price, and Online status.

name: Android Agent install actions are always visible
description: Verifies the current Android Agent APK can be reached directly from the website without opening GitHub manually.
steps: Confirm Install app and Download Agent APK buttons are visible
Sign in as Phone owner and open Dashboard
expected: Both Agent actions are visible on the home page and host dashboard and point to the current current optimized Agent build.

name: Existing phone reconnects without creating a duplicate
setup: Sign in as Phone owner
Have one existing phone in My phones
description: Verifies reinstalling the Agent does not require adding the phone again.
steps: Tap Reconnect Agent on the existing phone
expected: A fresh pairing code appears for the same phone and the phone count does not increase.

name: Host can delete an old phone cleanly
setup: Sign in as Phone owner
Have a phone listed in My phones
description: Verifies an obsolete phone can be removed from both the owner dashboard and shared catalog.
expected: The phone disappears from My phones and no longer appears in Catalog.

name: Online phone can be reserved by one renter
setup: Have one PhoneBridge Agent online in Catalog
Sign in to PhoneBridge
description: Verifies starting a rental locks that physical phone and opens an active timed session.
steps: Tap Rent on the online phone
expected: A Remote session screen opens, the timer starts, and the same phone is marked Busy for other renters.

name: Renter can end an active rental
setup: Start an active rental
description: Verifies ending a rental releases the phone and stops the session.
expected: The session closes and the online phone becomes available again.

name: Active rental accepts remote touch controls
setup: Start an active rental with a live PhoneBridge screen stream
Enable PhoneBridge Remote Control in Android Accessibility settings
description: Verifies the renter UI exposes direct touch gestures and navigation controls only inside the active rental screen.
steps: Tap a visible point on the streamed Android screen
Swipe vertically on the streamed screen
expected: The browser sends normalized control commands through the active rental WebSocket while the rental remains active.

name: Remote text input reaches focused Android field
setup: Start an active rental
Enable PhoneBridge Remote Control in Android Accessibility settings
description: Verifies the renter can send text to the currently focused editable field on the rented Android phone.
steps: Tap a text field on the remote phone
Enter text in the PhoneBridge text box
expected: The text is written into the focused Android input field without leaving the active rental.

name: Viewer reconnects after a short WebSocket interruption
setup: Start an active rental with live screen streaming
description: Verifies a short browser-side WebSocket interruption reconnects automatically while the rental remains active.
expected: PhoneBridge reconnects automatically and resumes live frames without creating a new rental.

name: Host can pause new rentals for a phone
setup: Sign in as Phone owner with one connected phone
description: Verifies the owner can stop or resume accepting new rentals without deleting or unpairing the phone.
steps: Return to Dashboard and tap Make available
expected: The phone remains connected but cannot be newly rented while paused, then becomes rentable again when resumed.

name: Renter tops up balance with a manual SOL transfer
setup: Sign in as a renter
Have any funded Solana wallet
description: Verifies a renter can create a deposit quote, manually send the exact SOL amount to the PhoneBridge treasury, paste the transaction signature, and receive internal USD balance after on-chain verification.
steps: Enter a USD amount and the sender Solana address
Copy the treasury address and exact SOL amount
Send the SOL manually from the stated wallet
Paste the finalized transaction signature and verify
expected: The treasury receives SOL and the renter balance increases exactly once.

name: Paid rental consumes renter balance and credits host earnings
setup: Have an online rentable phone owned by another user
Fund the renter balance with at least $1
description: Verifies paid sessions are limited by available prepaid balance and settle the 50 percent host share.
expected: The renter is charged for elapsed time and half of the charge is added to the host withdrawable balance.

name: Host submits a manual SOL withdrawal request
setup: Sign in as a host with withdrawable earnings
Have a Solana address for payout
description: Verifies a host can enter a payout address manually and reserve part of earnings for a manual SOL payout.
expected: A pending withdrawal request is created with the host wallet address and the requested USD value is removed from available host earnings.

name: Admin payout page is restricted to one authenticated email
setup: Sign in with the configured admin account
Have at least one pending host withdrawal
description: Verifies the Admin navigation and payout queue are available only to the single configured authenticated email, with the same restriction enforced by the backend.
steps: Sign in with the configured admin email and open Admin
Confirm pending payout requests are visible
Sign in with a different account and attempt the same API/page access
expected: Only the configured admin email can access the Admin page or payout APIs; all other authenticated users receive no Admin navigation and a 403 from protected admin APIs.

name: Active rental survives Render reservation memory loss
setup: Start an active rental
Clear or restart the Render Agent API so its in-memory reservation is lost
Keep the Android Agent online
description: Verifies AppDeploy DB remains the source of truth and restores the same rental into Render after a service restart.
steps: Wait for the next active-session reconciliation
expected: The same rental ID, render session ID and viewer access are restored without allowing a second renter to take the phone.

name: Long-offline phone ends rental without charging the offline tail
setup: Start a paid rental
Take the Android phone offline long enough to exceed the offline threshold
description: Verifies a long offline period automatically ends the durable rental and releases the phone.
steps: Close the renter browser or leave it in the background
Open Finance after the rental ends
expected: The background reconciliation closes the session after the long-offline threshold, releases the durable phone lock and caps billing near the last valid heartbeat grace window even when the renter page is not open.

name: Live session refresh does not rebuild the streaming DOM
setup: Start an active rental with live video
description: Verifies background reconciliation does not repeatedly replace the live stream UI or reconnect an already healthy viewer socket.
steps: Keep the rental open for at least 45 seconds
Switch the browser tab to background and back
expected: Video remains stable while active, hidden tabs stop periodic refresh work, and returning to the tab performs one reconciliation.

name: Host can emergency-stop an active rental
setup: Have a host phone actively rented by another account
description: Verifies the phone owner can force-end an active rental from the host dashboard without having access to the renter account.
steps: Confirm the rented phone shows Stop rental
expected: The active rental ends, remote access is released, final billing is settled once, and the phone becomes available again.

name: Finance page shows a unified transaction history
setup: Have at least one completed balance or rental operation
description: Verifies financial movements are recorded in one readable history instead of being visible only in separate forms.
expected: Finance shows dated entries with clear positive, negative or informational USD amounts for completed operations.
